mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_messenger_message ( tenant_id, conversation_id, psid, message_id, message_type, content, direction, send_time, status, media_id, media_url, media_mime_type, filename, raw_json, source, create_time ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{conversationId}, #{psid}, #{messageId}, #{messageType}, #{content}, #{direction}, #{sendTime}, #{status}, #{mediaId}, #{mediaUrl}, #{mediaMimeType}, #{filename}, #{rawJson}, #{source}, #{createTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, conversation_id, psid, message_id, message_type, content, direction, send_time, status, media_id, media_url, media_mime_type, filename, raw_json, source, create_time FROM crm_messenger_message WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND message_id = #{messageId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, tenant_id, conversation_id, psid, message_id, message_type, content, direction, send_time, status, media_id, media_url, media_mime_type, filename, raw_json, source, create_time FROM crm_messenger_message WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, tenant_id, conversation_id, psid, message_id, message_type, content, direction, send_time, status, media_id, media_url, media_mime_type, filename, raw_json, source, create_time FROM crm_messenger_message WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND media_url = #{mediaUrl} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
